author: TeIq
content:
PR 1 implementation landed (4 files, +566 lines, zero Rust changes).

## Files
- lexicons/polaris/escalation.json (124 lines) — gay.dollspace.polaris.escalation record (Q1-A namespace, Q3-B scope, Q4-A subject-shape)
- lexicons/polaris/observation.json (105 lines) — gay.dollspace.polaris.observation defs (5 kinds: imageHashCluster, accountCohort, replyBrigade, externalLabel, classifierSignal)
- lexicons/polaris/evidence-pointer.json (32 lines) — gay.dollspace.polaris.evidencePointer (carCid + mediaType + byteLength)
- lexicons/README.md (305 lines) — backcompat policy + Rule 1/2/3 + complete worked example (priorityHint addition)

## Verification
- JSON parses cleanly (python3 -m json.tool) on all three files
- Privacy boundary clean: zero `moderatorId`/`moderator_id`/`auditChainHash`/`audit_chain`/`reporterDid`/`reporter_did`/`exposureMetadata` substrings across all three lexicons
- All fields carry `description` (Lexicon validator surfaces in errors)
- Field naming camelCase per ATProto convention
- README sections: contents, architecture, three rules, worked-example (JSON diff + codegen sketch + mapping sketch), validation commands, naming conventions

## Implementation notes flagged for PR 2 review
1. `embeddedObservation` uses ATProto-idiomatic `confidence + observation` union (`$type` discriminator) instead of separate `kind + payload` fields — eliminates the kind/payload.$type drift hazard. Confirm proto-blue codegen handles this shape.
2. `observationKind` standalone enum def retained for potential XRPC-filter use later; if PR 2 finds it unused, remove.
3. `ReportVolumeAnomaly` + `ModeratorBehaviorAnomaly` v1 observation variants excluded from the wire union — they carry `ModeratorId` and operator-internal accounting that violates the privacy boundary.
4. Refs use bare-NSID form (`gay.dollspace.polaris.evidencePointer`); PR 2 must confirm proto-blue-codegen treats bare NSID = `#main` fragment.
